Rodriguez Custom Road Randonneur Bikes - The Rainier™
Rainier™ Image Gallery
Rodriguez Rainier™ - The classic Road Bike
The Rainier™ is our best selling 'rim brake' bike. It's not only comfortable to ride, it's a light, fast, classic road bike with a unique feature. It fits up to 32c tires with fenders. For racing, commuting or daily riding, this bike rocks. All of this, and hand made in the U.S.A just for you.
• Fits up to 32c tires with fenders
• 3 bottle mounts
• Hidden fender & rear rack mounts...just in case
• Built to ISO standards - Serviceable anywhere
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• No compromise on comfort - It's just your size!
• Anything else....Just ask!
Full bike from $3,399 Meet the Rainier™! Read More...
In 2008, we thought the world needed a classic road bike that could fit wider tires and fenders. Well, we were way ahead of our time.
We've designed and spec'd our own light weight steel fork just for use with this bike, as well as a Rodriguez custom carbon fork available as an upgrade for $295. In addition to more tire options, the Rainier™ includes more standard braze-ons than other road bikes. Mount up to 3 water bottles, a rear rack, and fenders easily.
If you're like me, and you like a classic, light weight road bike with narrow tires in the summer, but also want the option to ride up to 32's with fenders in the rainy season, this is the bike! The Rainier™, unlike so many other road bikes, gives you a wide range of rim and tire choices. lots of clearance for full fenders, fittings for a rear rack, and just about any gearing option you desire.
Now, if you're a race bike purist, and you're sure you don't even want the ability to run fenders or wider tires, we make those bikes too. The Rodriguez Outlaw series, all race, all the time.
Now available in
Step Through design!
Just $300 extra
The Rainier is a 2 for 1 really. You get all of the performance of a standard road bike, with the ability to run a little wider if you decide to (and most people do). The hidden fender and rack mounts are there just in case you decide you want put a rack on the bike for some credit card touring. Even if you never need them, they are there...just in case.
"Why would anyone want fenders, wider tires, a rack, and a wide range of gears?" asks the bike designers for the other companies. Well, it just so happens that our customers want to ride their bikes no matter what mother nature throws at them, or what hills or mountains they encounter. They got tired of bikes that whimpered at the thought of a little rain and started cutting and customizing fenders (albeit pretty crudely) to fit their race bikes. They didn't want the weight of a full touring bike, or a heavier disc brake bike...they wanted a race bike...but with fenders, durable tires, more gearing options, and a rear rack, all a must for the weekend tourist or daily commuter (at least in Seattle).

Yes! We ship bikes anywhere. Quick facts:
Don't let the fenders fool you! The Rodriguez Rainier™ is just as light and fast as any road bike on the market today. Of course, the Rainier™ is American made from high quality butted steel tubing. This provides the classic light-weight 'steel feel' the Rodriguez road bikes are famous for. We offer the Rainier™ with a selection of SRAM or Shimano equipment. Every Rainier™ comes with a pair of handbuilt wheels with a 2-year warranty. It's a comfortable, versatile bike that is perfect for a full day's ride and our fit is guaranteed.
Sizes: All of our bikes are offered in 20 production sizes . If you don't fit one of our production sizes, a custom size frame in any model is just $200 extra.
Paint Options. Decal Options:
With a Rodriguez, you can get a custom look for less. All Rodriguez bicycles come in your choice of 16 standard paint colors or for a few $$ extra you can choose from dozens of our snazzy colors in stock. We have four different styles of decals to choose from in . If you have a special paint design in mind, just let us know the design, and we'll quote it for you.
For those ready to tour the world, we're offering the Touring travel version that uses S&S couplings and fits in a 26" X 26" suitcase.
